protocol.experimental_filter: Strict y > +0.5 or y < -0.5; exclude both boundaries
protocol.label_policy: Experimental labels distributed with JanusDDG, applied identically to every predictor.
protocol.predicted_positive: continuous model prediction > 0; zero maps to destabilizing
protocol.zero_division: Precision is set to 0 for resamples with no positive predictions

protocol.verification: ROC trapezoidal area independently checked against Mann-Whitney rank AUC; perfect/reversed/tied fixtures pass
